# toll-booth

> toll-booth is the server side of HTTP 402 payments: it gates any HTTP API so that AI agents and other clients can pay for and consume it using Lightning (L402), Cashu, LNURLcash, x402 stablecoins, or IETF Payment (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01) - no accounts, no API keys, no human in the loop. It's payment-rail agnostic HTTP 402 middleware that embeds in your Node.js app or runs as a gateway in front of any HTTP service, supporting Express 5, Hono, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers. The client side, where an agent discovers and pays, is 402-mcp.

toll-booth is the only middleware that accepts L402, x402, Cashu, and IETF Payment (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01) simultaneously. It embeds in your Node.js application as middleware, or runs as a reverse proxy gateway in front of any HTTP service; either way it forwards authorised requests to the `upstream` URL you configure. It supports Express 5, Hono, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers. Five Lightning backends are supported (Phoenixd, LND, Core Lightning, LNbits, NWC), or you can run in Cashu-only mode with no Lightning node at all - ideal for serverless and edge deployments. x402 stablecoin payments (Coinbase's on-chain payment protocol), xcashu (NUT-24) direct-header Cashu payments, LNURLcash bearer notes (proposed LUD-25) and IETF Payment (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01, an expired IETF Internet-Draft, not a standard) are also supported via pluggable payment rails.

The closest alternative is Aperture (Lightning Labs), a Go reverse proxy that requires LND. toll-booth is TypeScript middleware that works with any Lightning backend, runs serverless, supports Cashu ecash, accepts x402 stablecoins, and implements IETF Payment (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01, an expired IETF Internet-Draft).

Payment rails are pluggable - a single toll-booth deployment can accept Lightning, Cashu (redeemCashu and xcashu), LNURLcash, x402 stablecoins, and IETF Payment simultaneously. The seller doesn't care how they get paid.

Try it instantly: `npx @forgesworn/toll-booth demo`

Scaffold a new project: `npx @forgesworn/toll-booth init` — interactive CLI that generates a ready-to-run project for your chosen framework (Express, Hono, Deno) and backend (Phoenixd, LND, NWC, Cashu-only).

## Getting Started

```bash
npm install @forgesworn/toll-booth express   # express and hono are optional peer dependencies; install the one you use
```

```typescript
import express from 'express'
import { Booth } from '@forgesworn/toll-booth'
import { phoenixdBackend } from '@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/phoenixd'

const app = express()
app.use(express.json())

const booth = new Booth({
  adapter: 'express',
  backend: phoenixdBackend({
    url: 'http://localhost:9740',
    password: process.env.PHOENIXD_PASSWORD!,
  }),
  pricing: { '/api/resource': 10 },
  upstream: 'http://localhost:8080',
})

app.get('/invoice-status/:paymentHash', booth.invoiceStatusHandler as any)
app.post('/create-invoice', booth.createInvoiceHandler as any)
app.use('/', booth.middleware as any)
app.listen(3000)
```

For Cashu-only mode (no Lightning node required):

```typescript
import { Booth } from '@forgesworn/toll-booth'
import { Wallet, getTokenMetadata, sumProofs } from '@cashu/cashu-ts'  // npm install @cashu/cashu-ts

const booth = new Booth({
  adapter: 'web-standard',
  redeemCashu: async (token, paymentHash) => {
    // Swap the proofs at the issuing mint. In production, store the result per paymentHash
    // and return it on a repeat call: crash recovery replays redeemCashu and expects the same answer.
    const wallet = new Wallet(getTokenMetadata(token).mint, { unit: 'sat' })
    await wallet.loadMint()
    const amountRedeemed = sumProofs(await wallet.receive(token)).toNumber()
    return amountRedeemed
  },
  pricing: { '/api/resource': 5 },
  upstream: 'http://localhost:8080',
})
```

## Key Concepts

- **Booth** — the main facade class. Instantiate with a config object, then wire `.middleware`, `.invoiceStatusHandler`, and `.createInvoiceHandler` into your router.
- **LightningBackend** — interface with two methods: `createInvoice(amountSats, memo?)` and `checkInvoice(paymentHash)`. Five implementations provided; implement your own for custom backends.
- **L402 flow** — client requests a priced endpoint, receives HTTP 402 with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pays the invoice, then sends `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>` to access the API.
- **Payment methods** — Lightning (via any backend), Cashu ecash tokens (via the `redeemCashu` callback or the xcashu NUT-24 rail), LNURLcash bearer notes, x402 stablecoins, and IETF Payment. NWC is one merchant-side Lightning backend, not a separate payer rail. Multiple rails run simultaneously on a single deployment.
- **Credit system** — payments grant a credit balance. Each request deducts from the balance. Volume discount tiers available via `creditTiers`.
- **Free tier** — optional per-IP daily allowance. Request-based: `freeTier: { requestsPerDay: N }`. Usage-based: `freeTier: { creditsPerDay: N }` (daily sats budget debited by each request's cost). Requests within the allowance bypass payment.
- **Payment rails** — pluggable payment rail abstraction (`PaymentRail` interface). Built-in rails: `createL402Rail()` for Lightning/macaroon auth, `createX402Rail()` for on-chain stablecoin payments, `createXCashuRail()` for xcashu (NUT-24), `createLnurlcashRail()` for LNURLcash notes, and `createIETFPaymentRail()` for IETF Payment (an expired Internet-Draft, not a standard). Multiple rails can run simultaneously on the same deployment.
- **IETF Payment** — implements draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01, an expired IETF Internet-Draft for HTTP-native payment authentication. HMAC-bound stateless challenges (no server state needed), Lightning settlement via any supported backend, and `Payment-Receipt` response header on successful auth. Enable with `ietfPayment: { realm: 'api.example.com' }` in Booth config.
- **Adapters** — `'express'` for Express 4/5, `'web-standard'` for Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers, and nothing else: `'hono'` is not a Booth adapter value. For Hono, use `createTollBooth()` with `createHonoTollBooth({ engine })` from `@forgesworn/toll-booth/hono` (auth middleware + `createPaymentApp()` sub-app). `createPaymentApp()` takes `defaultAmount` (the same setting as `defaultInvoiceAmount`), and its `storage` and `rootKey` must be the same instance and value given to `createTollBooth()`.
- **Event hooks** — three optional callbacks for observing the payment lifecycle: `onPayment` (fires once per payment hash on first successful auth; receives `{ timestamp, paymentHash, amountSats, currency, rail }`), `onRequest` (fires on every authenticated or free-tier request; receives `{ timestamp, endpoint, satsDeducted, remainingBalance, latencyMs, authenticated, currency, tier }`), and `onChallenge` (fires when a 402 challenge is issued; receives `{ timestamp, endpoint, amountSats }`). Pass them in the Booth config or engine config. Use for logging, analytics, webhook dispatch, or metrics.
- **Selective route gating** — only routes listed in the `pricing` map are gated. Pricing keys match one path exactly (after normalisation; there is no prefix or wildcard matching), so `'/api'` prices `/api` but not `/api/joke`. A value is a number of sats, `{ sats, usd }`, or a tiered map with a `default` key. Unpriced routes pass through free by default (`strictPricing: false`; a startup warning is emitted when pricing is configured in this mode). Enable `strictPricing: true` to gate all routes at `defaultInvoiceAmount`. Each adapter prices and forwards one canonical path (dot segments resolved, encoded unreserved characters decoded, duplicate slashes collapsed; encoded `/`, `\`, `.` segments and backslashes rejected with 400). Pricing lookups ignore trailing slashes and are case-insensitive. You can also mount the middleware on a specific Express path prefix (e.g. `app.use('/api/paid', booth.middleware)`) to scope gating to a subset of routes.
- **Custom macaroon caveats** — the `/create-invoice` endpoint accepts a `caveats` array of `"key = value"` strings (up to 16 caveats, max 1024 chars each). Built-in caveats verified by toll-booth: `route` (path restriction with wildcards), `expires` (ISO 8601 expiry), `ip` (client IP binding). Custom caveats (any non-reserved key) are parsed and forwarded to your upstream as `X-Toll-Caveat-{Key}: value` request headers. Your upstream enforces them as restrictions only: the client chooses caveats, so they never grant access. Client-sent `X-Toll-*` and `X-Credit-Balance` headers are stripped before proxying. Example: `caveats: ["model = llama3", "tier = basic"]` results in headers `X-Toll-Caveat-Model: llama3` and `X-Toll-Caveat-Tier: basic`.
- **Payment state in handlers** — after successful auth, Hono handlers access payment details via typed context variables: `c.get('tollBoothCreditBalance')`, `c.get('tollBoothPaymentHash')`, `c.get('tollBoothEstimatedCost')`, `c.get('tollBoothFreeRemaining')`, `c.get('tollBoothTier')`, `c.get('tollBoothAction')`. Express and Web Standard adapters add `X-Credit-Balance` and `X-Free-Remaining` headers to the client response, and forward `X-Credit-Balance`, `X-Toll-Tier` and `X-Toll-Caveat-*` headers to the upstream service. The Hono middleware sets the same headers on the request its handlers see.

## Event Hooks Example

```typescript
const booth = new Booth({
  adapter: 'express',
  backend: phoenixdBackend({ url: 'http://localhost:9740', password: process.env.PHOENIXD_PASSWORD! }),
  pricing: { '/api/resource': 10 },
  upstream: 'http://localhost:8080',
  onPayment: (event) => {
    console.log(`Payment: ${event.amountSats} sats via ${event.rail} (${event.paymentHash})`)
  },
  onRequest: (event) => {
    console.log(`${event.endpoint} -${event.satsDeducted} sats, ${event.remainingBalance} remaining`)
  },
  onChallenge: (event) => {
    console.log(`Challenged ${event.endpoint} for ${event.amountSats} sats`)
  },
})
```

## Selective Route Gating Example

```typescript
// Only /api/premium and /api/generate are gated; all other routes pass free
const booth = new Booth({
  adapter: 'express',
  backend: phoenixdBackend({ url: 'http://localhost:9740', password: process.env.PHOENIXD_PASSWORD! }),
  pricing: {
    '/api/premium': 100,
    '/api/generate': 50,
  },
  upstream: 'http://localhost:8080',
})

app.use('/', booth.middleware as express.RequestHandler)
// /api/premium -> 402 challenge (100 sats)
// /api/generate -> 402 challenge (50 sats)
// /api/search, /health, /docs -> pass through free

// Alternative: mount middleware on a specific prefix
app.use('/api/paid', booth.middleware as express.RequestHandler)
app.get('/api/free', (req, res) => res.json({ free: true }))  // unaffected

// Or gate everything with strictPricing
const strictBooth = new Booth({
  adapter: 'express',
  backend: phoenixdBackend({ url: 'http://localhost:9740', password: process.env.PHOENIXD_PASSWORD! }),
  upstream: 'http://localhost:8080',
  strictPricing: true,           // all routes gated at defaultInvoiceAmount
  defaultInvoiceAmount: 10,
  pricing: { '/health': 0 },    // explicitly free
})
```

## Custom Macaroon Caveats Example

```bash
# Request an invoice with custom caveats
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/create-invoice \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"amountSats": 1000, "caveats": ["model = llama3", "tier = basic"]}'
```

When the client authenticates, toll-booth forwards custom caveats to your upstream as headers:
- `X-Toll-Caveat-Model: llama3`
- `X-Toll-Caveat-Tier: basic`

Built-in caveats (verified automatically by toll-booth):
- `route = /api/*` — restrict macaroon to specific paths (supports wildcards)
- `expires = <ISO 8601 UTC timestamp in the future>` - time-limited access; a past timestamp is rejected immediately
- `ip = 203.0.113.1` — bind to a specific client IP

## Accessing Payment State Example

### Hono

```typescript
const app = new Hono<TollBoothEnv>()
app.use('/api/*', tollBooth.authMiddleware)
app.get('/api/resource', (c) => {
  const balance = c.get('tollBoothCreditBalance')   // remaining credits (sats)
  const hash = c.get('tollBoothPaymentHash')         // payment hash (if just paid)
  const cost = c.get('tollBoothEstimatedCost')        // cost of this request (sats)
  const free = c.get('tollBoothFreeRemaining')        // free-tier requests left
  const tier = c.get('tollBoothTier')                 // credit tier name
  return c.json({ message: 'Paid content', balance, tier })
})
```

### Express / Web Standard (client-side)

```typescript
const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/api/resource', {
  headers: { Authorization: `L402 ${macaroon}:${preimage}` },
})
const balance = Number(res.headers.get('X-Credit-Balance'))  // remaining credits
const freeLeft = Number(res.headers.get('X-Free-Remaining')) // free-tier (if applicable)
```

## API Surface

Main entry point: `import { Booth } from '@forgesworn/toll-booth'`

Subpath imports for tree-shaking:
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/phoenixd` — Phoenixd backend
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/lnd` — LND backend
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/cln` — Core Lightning backend
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/lnbits` — LNbits backend
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/backends/nwc` — Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47) backend
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/storage/sqlite` — SQLite storage (default)
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/storage/memory` — in-memory storage (testing)
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/adapters/express` — Express middleware factory
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/adapters/web-standard` — Web Standard handler factory
- `@forgesworn/toll-booth/hono` — Hono middleware + payment route sub-app (`createHonoTollBooth`)

Payment rail factories (for multi-rail setups):
- `createL402Rail(config)` — L402 Lightning + macaroon rail
- `createX402Rail(config)` — x402 on-chain stablecoin rail (requires a facilitator)
- `createXCashuRail(config, storage?)` - xcashu (NUT-24) direct-header Cashu rail; `config` is `{ mints, unit?, onProofsReceived? }`
- `createLnurlcashRail(config, storage?)` - LNURLcash (proposed LUD-25) bearer-note rail; `config` is `{ mints, unit?, requireSignature?, timeoutMs?, onNoteReceived? }`
- `createIETFPaymentRail(config)` — IETF Payment rail (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01, stateless Lightning)
- `createIETFSessionRail(config)` - IETF Payment session intent rail

Engine, storage and handlers (all exported from the main entry point):
- `createTollBooth(config)` - framework-agnostic engine; `config` is `TollBoothCoreConfig` (`storage`, `rootKey`, `pricing` and `upstream` required). Pass the engine to `createHonoTollBooth({ engine })`.
- `sqliteStorage({ path? })` - SQLite `StorageBackend` (in-memory when `path` is omitted); also at `@forgesworn/toll-booth/storage/sqlite`
- `memoryStorage()` - in-memory `StorageBackend` for tests
- `handleCreateInvoice(deps, request)`, `handleInvoiceStatus(...)`, `handleCashuRedeem(deps, request)` - the core handlers behind the adapters' routes
- `meltNoteToLightning({ noteUrl, createInvoice, timeoutMs? })` - sweep an LNURLcash note onto your own node; `createInvoice` is `(amountSats: number) => Promise<string>` returning a BOLT-11 invoice
- `meltToLightning` - Cashu-to-Lightning melt utility
- `StatsCollector` - in-memory usage analytics; `Booth` exposes an instance as `.stats`

Booth instance properties:
- `.middleware` — main request handler (checks auth, proxies upstream)
- `.invoiceStatusHandler` — GET /invoice-status/:paymentHash
- `.createInvoiceHandler` — POST /create-invoice
- `.cashuRedeemHandler` — POST /cashu-redeem (when redeemCashu configured)
- `.resetFreeTier()` — reset daily free-tier counters
- `.close()` — clean up timers and database connections
